pairs.target: dìyī guō fàn màiwán shí ,
pairs.english: When the first pot of rice sold out,

pairs.target: yīwén hái méi lái .
pairs.english: Iven still hadn't arrived.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi guǒrán kànjiàn le guōdǐ ,
pairs.english: Sure enough, Tavi could see the bottom of the pot.

pairs.target: guōdǐ bìng bú liàng ,
pairs.english: The bottom was not exactly shiny:

pairs.target: niánzhuó yìquān jiāo mǐ .
pairs.english: a ring of scorched rice stuck to it.

pairs.target: mài fàn de rén ná mù sháo qiāo le qiāo guō yán ,
pairs.english: The person selling rice took a wooden ladle and gave the rim of the pot a tap.
pairs.hanzi: 卖饭的人拿木勺敲了敲锅沿，

pairs.target: wèn tā shì zài děng fàn háishì děng rén .
pairs.english: and asked whether he was waiting for rice or for somebody.
pairs.hanzi: 问他是在等饭还是等人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děng rén ,
pairs.english: Tavi said he was waiting for somebody.

pairs.target: suíjí yòu shuō fàn yě yào ,
pairs.english: Then he said he wanted rice too,

pairs.target: zìjǐ xiān chī .
pairs.english: and would eat first himself.

pairs.target: tā duānwǎn zǒu dào ménkǒu ,
pairs.english: He carried his bowl to the door

pairs.target: cái kànjiàn yīwén zuòzài shíjiē xià ,
pairs.english: and only then saw Iven sitting below the stone steps,
pairs.hanzi: 才看见伊文坐在石阶下，

pairs.target: zhèng ná zhǐshàn fēng .
pairs.english: fanning himself with a sheet of paper.

pairs.target: yīwén shuō guì kǒu nàbiān méi guānmén ,
pairs.english: Iven said the counter over there hadn't closed,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说柜口那边没关门，

pairs.target: kě guǎn dǐcè de rén zǒu le ,
pairs.english: but the person in charge of the ledger had left,

pairs.target: shèngxià de rén bùnéng tì tā kāisuǒ .
pairs.english: and the people still there couldn't unlock it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 剩下的人不能替他开锁。

pairs.target: tā báipǎo le yítàng ,
pairs.english: He had made the trip for nothing.

pairs.target: lùshang yòu xián zìjǐ pǎo dé tài kuài ,
pairs.english: On the way back he felt he was running much too fast,
pairs.hanzi: 路上又嫌自己跑得太快，

pairs.target: biàn zài jiēxià zuò le yíhuìer . "
pairs.english: so he sat a little while below the steps.

pairs.target: nǐ búshì kàndéjiàn guōdǐ me ? "
pairs.english: “Couldn't you see the bottom of the pot?”

pairs.target: yīwén wèn . "
pairs.english: Iven asked.

pairs.target: wǒ kànbújiàn táijiē dǐxià . "
pairs.english: “I can't see what's below the steps.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ wǎn wǎng pángbiān nuó le nuó ,
pairs.english: Tavi moved his bowl a little to one side,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把碗往旁边挪了挪，

pairs.target: gěi tā ràngchū yíkuài gān de dìfāng .
pairs.english: making a spot on the dry ground for him.
pairs.hanzi: 给他让出一块干的地方。

pairs.target: yīwén méi zuò guòqù ,
pairs.english: Iven didn't go over and sit there,

pairs.target: xiānjìn qù mǎi le dìèr guō de fàn ,
pairs.english: but went inside first to buy rice from the second pot.
pairs.hanzi: 先进去买了第二锅的饭，

pairs.target: chūlái shí duō ná le yìshuāng kuàizi .
pairs.english: When he came out he had picked up an extra pair of chopsticks.
pairs.hanzi: 出来时多拿了一双筷子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu yí kàn ,
pairs.english: Tavi dropped his eyes for a look:

pairs.target: zìjǐ de nàshuāng hái liúzài guìshàng .
pairs.english: his own pair was still back on the counter.
pairs.hanzi: 自己的那双还留在柜上。

pairs.target: cìrì shàngwǔ , jiǎn lǎoshī dú le tā de biǎo .
pairs.english: The next morning Instructor Jian looked over the form he had written.
pairs.hanzi: 次日上午，简老师读了他的表。

pairs.target: dú dào kònggé shí , tā méiyǒu tíng ,
pairs.english: She didn't stop when she reached the blank box.

pairs.target: fǎnér zài xiàbiān nà xíng zìpáng huà le yídào duǎnxiàn ,
pairs.english: Instead she drew one short mark beside that line of writing below,
pairs.hanzi: 反而在下边那行字旁画了一道短线，

pairs.target: wèn tā zěnme zhīdào zhǐ zhēnde dào le nàge rén shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: and asked him how he knew the note had really reached the hands of that person.
pairs.hanzi: 问他怎么知道纸真的到了那个人手里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yào tīng duìfāng huí yíjù ;
pairs.english: Tavi said he'd need to hear the person say something back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说要听对方回一句；

pairs.target: ruò zhī tīng biérén shuō kànguò ,
pairs.english: If he only heard someone else say it had been read,

pairs.target: hái dé wèn shì shuí kàn de .
pairs.english: he'd still have to ask who had read it.

pairs.target: lǎoshī bǎ biǎo zhuǎnguò lái ,
pairs.english: The teacher turned the form around

pairs.target: wèn tā shìfǒu yuànyì xiān zài yuànlǐ shì .
pairs.english: and asked whether he was willing to try it in the courtyard first.
pairs.hanzi: 问他是否愿意先在院里试。

pairs.target: yuànmén ,
pairs.english: The courtyard gate,

pairs.target: láng kǒu ,
pairs.english: the corridor entrance,

pairs.target: shítáng ,
pairs.english: or the dining hall:

pairs.target: xuǎn yíchù ,
pairs.english: choose one place,

pairs.target: zhǎo yígè tóngyì de rén ,
pairs.english: and find one person who agrees.

pairs.target: zhī zǒu yìhuí ,
pairs.english: Make just one run,

pairs.target: bù qǐng ménfáng tì tāmen zhǎo shuí .
pairs.english: and don't ask the gatekeeper to find anyone for them.

pairs.target: ruò yuēdìng de rén bú zài ,
pairs.english: If the person they had made arrangements with wasn't there,

pairs.target: jiù huílái zhàoshí shuō ,
pairs.english: come back and tell it as it happened.

pairs.target: bù tiān dìèrtiáo lù .
pairs.english: Don't add a second route.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn néng bunéng qù hòuchē péng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether he could go to the waiting shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问能不能去候车棚。

pairs.target: lǎoshī shuō jīnrì bùnéng ,
pairs.english: The teacher said no, not today.

pairs.target: xiān kàn yuànlǐ nà yìhuí huì buhuì jiào rén bái děng .
pairs.english: First see whether that one run in the courtyard would leave anybody waiting for nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 先看院里那一回会不会叫人白等。

pairs.target: tā chūménshí yùjiàn pà wò ,
pairs.english: He met Pavo on his way out the door,

pairs.target: biàn wèn tā wǔhòu kěnbukěn lái shōu yìzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: so he asked if Pavo would come that afternoon to receive a note.
pairs.hanzi: 便问他午后肯不肯来收一张纸。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō kěyǐ ,
pairs.english: Pavo said yes,

pairs.target: dàn tā zhī zài shàiyīshéng xià děng ,
pairs.english: but he would only wait under the clothesline.

pairs.target: bùnéng wèi yìzhāng zhǐ cóngtóudàowěi bù fān zìjǐ de bèizi .
pairs.english: He couldn't spend the whole time without turning his own quilt just for a note.
pairs.hanzi: 不能为一张纸从头到尾不翻自己的被子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài biǎo shàng xiě le shàiyīshéng ,
pairs.english: On the form Tavi wrote down clothesline,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在表上写了晒衣绳，

pairs.target: yòu wèn děngdào shénme shíchén .
pairs.english: and then asked until what time he would wait.

pairs.target: pà wò piējiàn tā bǎ bǐjiān xuán zài kōnglán shàng ,
pairs.english: Pavo saw him hold the tip of his pen suspended above the blank space,
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃瞥见他把笔尖悬在空栏上，

pairs.target: shēnshǒu bǎ zhǐ wǎng zìjǐ zhèbiān lā le yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: and reached over to pull the paper a little toward himself.
pairs.hanzi:
伸手把纸往自己这边拉了一点。

“

pairs.target: děng wǒ bǎ bèizi fānguòlái . "
pairs.english: “Until I turn my quilt over,”

pairs.target: tā shuō , "
pairs.english: he said.

pairs.target: nǐ yàoshi zhǎobùzhe wǒ ,
pairs.english: “If you can't find me,

pairs.target: xiān kànkàn nǎ miàncháo shàng . "
pairs.english: look first at which side is facing up.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too.

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mǎshàng luòbǐ ,
pairs.english: He didn't put pen to paper right away.

pairs.target: xiān wèn pà wò nà chuáng bèizi liǎngmiàn jiūjìng yǒu shénme bùtóng .
pairs.english: First he asked Pavo what exactly was different about the two sides of his quilt.
pairs.hanzi: 先问帕沃那床被子两面究竟有什么不同。

pairs.target: pà wò dá dé gāncuì ,
pairs.english: Pavo answered promptly:

pairs.target: yímiàn yǒu tàiyáng ,
pairs.english: one side had sun,

pairs.target: yímiàn méiyǒu .
pairs.english: and the other side didn't.

pairs.target: liǎng rén zhàn zài ménkǒu xiào le yízhèn ,
pairs.english: They laughed for a bit standing in the doorway,
pairs.hanzi: 两人站在门口笑了一阵，

pairs.target: háishì huíqù jiè le gè shālòu .
pairs.english: but went back and borrowed an hourglass all the same.
